title: Fines, fees and charges.
bodyText: All moneys collected under this part shall be paid into the state highway fund and shall be expended for the purpose of this part.
bodyHtml: [§286-216]  Fines, fees and charges.  All moneys collected under this part shall be paid into the state highway fund and shall be expended for the purpose of this part. [L Sp 1977 1st, c 20, pt of §1]
